reasons: With a 4 MC per-semester limit, each active semester can hold only one 4 MC course.
The Y3S2 exchange leaves only semesters 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8 active, so at most 5 courses can be taken.
The student must take 8 listed courses, and some require added prerequisites, so no plan satisfies all rules.
